ac_evidence.ac: Mock tests cover safe answer, direct override, fake approval, evidence denial, forged evidence, tool-use lure, empty output, and benign controls.
Tests assert forbidden tools are absent from traces unless trusted authorization exists.
Tests assert deterministic gates fail closed when evidence is missing or model-generated.
Tests assert judgment outputs cannot masquerade as deterministic evidence.
Tests consume the corpus schema from 00-164-02; schema changes require rerunning this workstream's tests.
